titulo: Folha de sons 5a — os chefões máquina
nota:
A Torre da F1 e a Capitânia da F2. A dor (o acerto no corpo) e a morte (o fim de chefão) já são da folha 2; aqui ficam os ataques, os avisos e os momentos.
A Torre é um METRÔNOMO (o leque a cada 1,9 s no chão, 1,35 s no ar): julgue o leque no ×8. A Capitânia é um NAVIO, "salva e silêncio": a bordada rola pelas 3 baterias, 0,2–0,3 s entre elas.
As versões C sintetizadas têm o tempo exato do jogo: a carga do míssil (0,65 s) e o pavio do flak (0,35 s).
A Torre abre na atmosfera (F1), a Capitânia na cabine (o vácuo da F2).

sons.oque: O LEQUE de 4 cometas — o metrônomo, com o recuo do canhão

versoes.nota: "a heavy alien defense tower cannon firing a fan of four glowing plasma comets at once, a deep punchy boom with a metallic recoil clank, outdoors in thin air, dark sci-fi, no music"
"a large fortress turret discharging a spread of energy bolts, a thick low thump with a short hiss of plasma and a heavy barrel recoil, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: O MIRADO — o cometa no ar, 0,4 s depois do leque

versoes.nota: "a single aimed plasma comet fired from a flying war tower, a quick hard thump with a rising sizzle, dark sci-fi, dry, no music"
"one heavy energy shot snapping out of a big gun barrel, a sharp dull crack with a short tail, dark sci-fi, dry, no music"

sons.oque: A CARGA DO MÍSSIL — os 0,65 s piscando antes de lançar

versoes.nota: "a big alien war machine charging a missile for two thirds of a second, a pulsing electric hum climbing fast with sparks crackling, dark sci-fi, dry, no music"
"a weapon system arming a guided missile, a quick rising whine with a throbbing pulse, short warning, dark sci-fi, dry, no music"
"sintetizado: 0,65 s (a carga do míssil), um zumbido subindo 90 → 260 Hz pulsando no ritmo do piscar, estalos por cima"
"a guided missile launched from a flying war tower, a heavy ignition whoosh and a rocket motor roaring away, in thin atmosphere, dark sci-fi, no music"
"a big rocket leaving its launcher, a deep thump and a rushing hiss of thrust fading into the distance, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: A DECOLAGEM — 1,3 s: os motores arrancando a Torre da base (as explosões da base já têm som)
sons.onde: a Torre, F1, na metade da vida

versoes.nota: "a massive armored tower tearing itself off its base and lifting into the air, huge thrusters igniting with a rising roar and metal groaning, one and a half seconds, dark sci-fi, no music"
"heavy jet engines spooling up and blasting a giant machine upward, a deep swelling rocket roar with a rumbling liftoff, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: O MOTOR NO AR (laço) — as plumas segurando a Torre

versoes.nota: "the steady thrusters of a heavy flying war tower hovering, a deep continuous jet rumble with a low turbine whine, continuous, seamless, no start or end, no music"
"big hover engines holding a massive machine in the air, a constant throbbing roar with a soft rattle, continuous, seamless, no start or end, no music"

sons.oque: O HANGAR — a baia largando os interceptadores (180 ms entre eles)

versoes.nota: "a warship's hangar bay opening and launching small attack drones one after another, a heavy hatch clank, a hiss and two or three quick launch thumps, heard through the hull in space, dark sci-fi, no music"
"a carrier ship catapult releasing fighters, a mechanical latch slam and quick muffled whooshes, low, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: A BORDADA — uma bateria (3–4 traçantes a 90 ms); as 3 baterias rolam em sequência

versoes.nota: "a battleship gun battery firing a quick burst of three heavy tracer rounds, three deep punchy cannon shots in rapid succession, muffled through a hull in space, dark sci-fi, no music"
"a naval broadside, a battery of heavy cannons thudding in a rolling triple burst, low and powerful, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: O FLAK — o lançar das cápsulas giratórias

versoes.nota: "a warship launching flak shells, a hollow mortar thump with a spinning whir of the shells flying out, dark sci-fi, no music"
"two spinning canisters fired from a heavy launcher, a deep pop and a tumbling whistle, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: O PAVIO DO FLAK — os últimos 0,35 s piscando

versoes.nota: "sintetizado: 0,35 s (o pavio do flak), tiques acelerando e subindo 900 → 1.400 Hz, o último no estouro"

sons.oque: O ESTOURO DO FLAK — o anel de 8 estilhaços

versoes.nota: "a flak shell bursting in space, a sharp concussive crack scattering hot shrapnel, short, muffled, dark sci-fi, no music"
"an airburst shell detonating, a dull heavy pop with fragments flying out in a ring, low, dark sci-fi, no music"

sons.oque: O MIRADO — o canhão principal, um tiro na nave

versoes.nota: "a warship's main gun firing one aimed heavy round, a deep cannon boom muffled through the hull in space, short, dark sci-fi, no music"
"a single big naval cannon shot, a hard low thud with a short metallic ring, dark sci-fi, dry, no music"

sons.oque: A FÚRIA — quando ela endurece o ritmo (o clarão)
sons.onde: a Capitânia, F2, na metade da vida

versoes.nota: "a damaged alien warship going into a frenzy, a deep blaring battle horn with a power surge and metal groaning, dark sci-fi, no music"
"a huge battleship overloading its reactor, a heavy rising electric hum, a low alarm wail and a hull shudder, dark sci-fi, no music"
